exec: Politically motivated website defacement of a sports body; no data loss reported.
impact: The federation's public website was taken offline.
plain: The world ice hockey body's website was hacked to show a pro-Russia message after Russia was left out of a junior tournament, then taken offline.

sources.name: BNN Bloomberg / CTV News live updates

summary: The IIHF website briefly showed an image of Russian players and a message criticising the federation on November 17, then went offline behind a maintenance notice. It followed the IIHF's confirmation that Russia will not play at next month's world junior championship in Canada. The IIHF condemned the attack and is investigating; no one has claimed it, and the Russian Hockey Federation condemned it. No data compromise is reported.
title: International Ice Hockey Federation website defaced with pro-Russia message

validation.note: AP via ESPN and The Canadian Press via TSN both report the defacement and the site going offline.

review.note: Compared title, date, offline/maintenance, condemnation, no claim and Russian federation reaction against ESPN/AP and TSN/CP; BNN not opened.
